alt: 左邊男孩只在桌角亂畫，被老師勸阻；右邊他反而把整張桌子與牆壁都塗滿亂紋，老師更加憂心。
scene_prompt: 變本加厲 means bad behavior grows worse after earlier misconduct, not simple increase in objects. An original two-panel wordless illustration on one textured ivory page, divided by a thin pencil line, depicting same mischievous teenage boy at the same school desk at successive times. LEFT smaller earlier panel: he scratches a small unauthorized pencil scribble on the edge of his desk; caring teacher behind him raises a calm warning hand. RIGHT larger later panel: despite the warning he smugly covers the entire desk and adjacent classroom wall with large tangled messy colorful graffiti scribbles while the teacher looks dismayed. The graffiti is purely abstract looping marks, absolutely no letters, numbers, words or recognizable symbols. Show clear escalation from a small offense to much worse disrespectful damage, no glorification. Keep each person's body separate, exactly two arms in each panel, drawing tool actually held in hand and contacting desk or wall. No time labels, arrows, dialogue or readable text.
